title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
text: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS. OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS, giving enterprises a new path to build with OpenAI through the AWS environments, controls, and procurement workflows they already use. Customers can get started with OpenAI on AWS and move faster from evaluation to production.
